description.purpose: Per-user operational cost: each month's total operational cost divided evenly across the users acquired that month (from core's seed_users, read cross-service). One row per user. A cost month with zero signups would be unallocated and absent here; today every one of the 24 cost months has a matching cohort, so any gap between this table's total and operational_costs_monthly's total is per-user cent rounding, not unallocated months. Per-user costs within a cohort can sum a few cents off the month's total due to rounding. Counterpart of marketing's marketing_cost_per_user; both feed ltv_per_user.

schema.name: operational_cost_per_user

properties.description: Matches core.seed_users.user_id, marketing's marketing_cost_per_user.user_id, and finance's transaction user ids.
properties.name: user_id

properties.description: Exact timestamp the user was acquired (seed_users.created_at), before truncation to acquisition_month.
properties.name: acquired_at

properties.description: First day of the month the user was acquired; the month whose total cost is divided.
properties.name: acquisition_month

properties.description: How many users were acquired in that month -- the divisor. Carried so the division can be reconstructed without re-deriving the cohort.
properties.name: users_in_cohort

properties.description: The user's even share of their acquisition month's total operational cost, in EUR. Always positive; never NULL.
properties.name: operational_cost_eur

properties.description: The variable share (cloud hosting, transaction fees) of this user's allocated operational cost. Subtracted from revenue to get contribution margin in ltv_per_user.
properties.name: variable_cost_eur
